items.source: Return a StandardStackTracePrinter that prints the stack trace with the root exception first (the opposite of Throwable.printStackTrace()).
items.translation: 返回一个StandardStackTracePrinter，它以根异常为首打印堆栈跟踪（与Throwable.printStackTrace()相反）。

items.source: Return a StandardStackTracePrinter that prints the stack trace with the root exception last (the same as Throwable.printStackTrace()).
items.translation: 返回一个StandardStackTracePrinter，该打印器将根异常置于最后打印（与Throwable.printStackTrace()相同）。

items.source: Return a new StandardStackTracePrinter from this one that will not print suppressed items.
items.translation: 返回一个新的 StandardStackTracePrinter，该实例不会打印 suppressed 项。

items.source: Return a new StandardStackTracePrinter from this one that will print all common frames rather the replacing them with the "... N more" message.
items.translation: 返回一个新的StandardStackTracePrinter，它将打印所有常见帧，而不是用"... N more"消息替换它们。

items.source: Return a new StandardStackTracePrinter from this one that will only include throwables (excluding caused and suppressed) that match the given predicate.
items.translation: 返回一个新的StandardStackTracePrinter，该实例仅包含符合给定谓词的异常（不包括原因和抑制的异常）。

items.source: Return a new StandardStackTracePrinter from this one uses the specified formatter to create a string representation of a throwable.
items.translation: 返回一个新的StandardStackTracePrinter，该实例使用指定的格式化程序来创建异常对象的字符串表示形式。

items.source: Return a new StandardStackTracePrinter from this one that will only include frames that match the given predicate.
items.translation: 返回一个新的StandardStackTracePrinter，该实例仅包含符合给定谓词的帧。

items.source: Return a new StandardStackTracePrinter from this one uses the specified formatter to create a string representation of a frame.
items.translation: 返回一个新的StandardStackTracePrinter，该实例使用指定的格式化器来创建帧的字符串表示形式。

items.source: Return a new StandardStackTracePrinter from this one that generates and prints hashes for each stacktrace.
items.translation: 返回一个新的StandardStackTracePrinter，该实例会为每个堆栈跟踪生成并打印哈希值。

items.source: Return a new StandardStackTracePrinter from this one that changes if hashes should be generated and printed for each stacktrace.
items.translation: 返回一个新的StandardStackTracePrinter，该实例会更改是否为每个堆栈跟踪生成并打印哈希值。

items.source: Return a new StandardStackTracePrinter from this one that print the stack trace using the specified line separator.
items.translation: 返回一个新的StandardStackTracePrinter，使用指定的行分隔符打印堆栈跟踪。

items.source: Return a new StandardStackTracePrinter from this one that will use ellipses to truncate output longer that the specified length.
items.translation: 返回一个新的StandardStackTracePrinter，该实例将使用省略号截断超过指定长度的输出。

items.source: Return a new StandardStackTracePrinter from this one that filter frames (including caused and suppressed) deeper then the specified maximum.
items.translation: 返回一个新的 StandardStackTracePrinter`，该实例会过滤掉深度超过指定最大值的堆栈帧（包括原因和抑制的帧）。

items.source: Uses of StandardStackTracePrinter in org.springframework.boot.logging
Support and abstractions across several logging libraries.
items.translation: 支持多种日志库的抽象功能。
